en: Hosea 4

p.src: 1  Hear the LORD’s word, you children of Israel, for the LORD has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.

ja: 民を訴える。 「まことに、この
en: Hear the LORD’s word, you children of Israel, for the LORD has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.
u.src: 1  Hear the LORD’s word, you children of Israel, for the LORD has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.

p.src: 2  There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.

en: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.
u.src: 2  There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.

p.src: 3  Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.

ja: む者は皆、衰え果てる。 そこにいるすべての生き物も、
en: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.
u.src: 3  Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.

p.src: 4  “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.

ja: しかし、だれも訴えてはならない。 だれも
めてはならない。 あなたの
en: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.
u.src: 4  “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.

p.src: 5  You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.

ja: 、あなたとともにつまずく。 私はあなたの
en: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.
u.src: 5  You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.

p.src: 6  My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.

ja: ぼされる。 あなたが
けたので、私もあなたを
とはしない。 あなたが
れたので、 私もあなたの
en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.
u.src: 6  My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.

p.src: 7  As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.

ja: えるほど、 私に対して
en: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.
u.src: 7  As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.

p.src: 8  They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.

en: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.
u.src: 8  They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.

p.src: 9  It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.

ja: じようになる。 私は彼らの歩みを罰し、
en: It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.
u.src: 9  It will be like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.

p.src: 10  They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned listening to the LORD.

ja: に従うことを捨てたからだ。
en: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned listening to the LORD.
u.src: 10  They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned listening to the LORD.

p.src: 11  Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.

en: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
u.src: 11  Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.

p.src: 12  My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.

ja: に伺いを立て、 杖に答えを
en: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.
u.src: 12  My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.

p.src: 13  They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.

ja: よい。 それゆえ、あなたがたの
en: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.
u.src: 13  They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks, poplars, and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.

p.src: 14  I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.

ja: をしても、私は罰しない。 あなたがたの
が娼婦たちと連れ立ち、
たちとともにいけにえをささげているからだ。
en: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.
u.src: 14  I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.

p.src: 15  “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As the LORD lives.’

ja: イスラエルよ、あなたが
させてはならない。 ギルガルに来てはならず、 ベテ・アベンに
en: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As the LORD lives.’
u.src: 15  “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As the LORD lives.’

p.src: 16  For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will the LORD feed them like a lamb in a meadow?

ja: のように、 ひどく頑なに振る舞った。
en: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will the LORD feed them like a lamb in a meadow?
u.src: 16  For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will the LORD feed them like a lamb in a meadow?

p.src: 17  Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!

ja: びついている。 そのままにしておけ。
en: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
u.src: 17  Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!

p.src: 18  Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.

ja: は酸っぱくなり、 それでも
en: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.
u.src: 18  Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.

p.src: 19  The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.

ja: たちのいけにえのゆえに
en: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
u.src: 19  The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
